question: How does this approach compare to other WSD approaches employing word embeddings?

extractive_spans: GM$\_$KL achieves better correlation than existing approaches for various metrics on SCWS dataset.
evidence: Table TABREF17 compares the performance of the approaches on the SCWS dataset. It is evident from Table TABREF17 that GM$\_$KL achieves better correlation than existing approaches for various metrics on SCWS dataset.

title: Learning Multi-Sense Word Distributions using Approximate Kullback-Leibler Divergence
answer_short: GM_KL achieves significantly better correlation scores than w2g and w2gm on most datasets, and captures entailment relations that other approaches fail to consider.
answer_rationale: The GM_KL model, which uses a KL divergence-based energy function, outperforms w2g and w2gm on benchmark datasets (Text 5). It specifically captures entailment relations (Text 9) and handles polysemy by modeling word embeddings as Gaussian mixtures (Text 6), whereas other approaches like BIBREF9 and BIBREF10 either fail to consider entailment or use different methods (Text 1).
